summary: Anton Birkenmaier, a mason of Munzingen in the 1850s, of the same Birkenmaier family as John's ancestors; the exact relationship is unknown.
bio: Anton Birkenmaier was a mason at Munzingen in Baden. He and his wife, née Scherer, lost a twin son, Stephan, in 1853. He belonged to the same Birkenmaier family group as John's ancestors, but his exact relationship to them is not known.
sources: Landesarchiv Baden-Württemberg, Staatsarchiv Freiburg, L 10 Nr. 1591 (Munzingen, Catholic parish, Standesbücher 1840–1870; 631 images; record id 5-480947) http://www.landesarchiv-bw.de/plink/?f=5-480947-286
